games.name: Heian [OPEN TESTING]
games.desc:
A game inspired by the Golden Age of Jujutsu.
There is no permadeath involved in the game.

Controls:
Q - Dodge
R - Critical
M1 - Basic attack
M2 - Feint
Tab - Inventory
2x W - Run
F - Parry / Block
B - Grip + Mouse
V - Carry
C - Charge CE
C + X - Curse Sense

Mechanics:
Roll Cancelling - Q + M2
Feinting - M1 + M2 or Skill
Running Attack - M1 while sprinting
Uptilt - Hold CTRL + M1
Aerial - M1 in Air
Chase - M1 during Aerial
M - Meditate (used to unlock moves)

You can unequip equipments through settings.
You can wipe / delete your character through the red skull icon in your slots UI
You can recall ur skills by clicking on the learned skill twice
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Contributions:
Programming: usdhha, NokiSou, DavidLocious
Building: RenneOri
Modelling: RenneOri
Animating: usdhha, NokiSou
VFX: pkvfx, usdhha, NokiSou

games.name: Windy City Roleplay [Console Support]
games.desc:
Welcome to Windy City Roleplay, where the city feels alive and your story matters. Dive into a serious roleplay experience built for players who want more than just another game.

Take on roles like police, EMS, civilian, or something a little more... risky. From traffic stops and shootouts to running businesses or hanging with your crew, the city is what you make it.

Features:

Real jobs with full systems (police, EMS, criminal, etc.)

Custom cars, animations, and scenes

A detailed city environment with houses, stores, and more

Serious RP with rules to keep it real

Active community and constant updates

Whether you're out to protect the city or stir up chaos, Windy City Roleplay lets you live out your story — your way.
